export_evidence: ImportKey page for MILACRON INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED (https://importkey.com/countries/india/milacron-india-private-limited) reports 'Total Shipments 64731 Records detected' and 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28', but every one of the 5 rows actually rendered on the free view is an INBOUND line, e.g. '2026-02-28 | SGO CO.,LTD. | MILACRON INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | 17) PARTS FOR INJECTION MOLDING MACHINE... | SEOUL INCHEON INT, SOUTH KOREA | SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | 84779000 | 7806766'. No outbound (India-origin) shipment row with date, destination, HS and B/L was visible. The 'Buyers' block does list foreign counterparties such as 'MILACRON PLASTICS TECHNOLOGIES ... NEW YORK, UNITED STATES' (6497 shipments) and 'M/S.MOLD-MASTERS EUROPA GMBH ... GERMANY' (1645), which is consistent with exports existing, but the free view shows no dated export B/L line, so export is not confirmed. Source counter: page claims 64731 shipments / 239 trading partners; rows actually seen = 5, all imports.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India sales split could be retrieved. thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, trademo returned HTTP 403, importgenius returned a JavaScript challenge page, and the web_search tool was unavailable (connection refused) for the whole session. Domestic supply therefore unverified — null, not estimated.
note: Legal entity exists and is clearly active in customs data (latest record 2026-02-28, 158 port lanes, 239 counterparties), so no rejection ground applies. HS 847989 declared by the requester is not what the observed records show: the visible lines carry HS 84779000 ('PARTS FOR INJECTION MOLDING MACHINE'), i.e. parts of machinery of heading 8477, not 8479. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — company stays in the base with the code corrected to the factual one (84779000 for the observed lines; the full product mix may include 8477.10 injection moulding machines, but that was not visible in the free view). The 'Ferromatik Milacron India Private Limited' slug on ImportKey (https://importkey.com/countries/india/ferromatik-milacron-india-private-limited) resolves to a page that renders 'Loading...' with zero records, so the Ferromatik name variant is not separately evidenced in customs data. Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is inconsistent with the observed goods (plastics injection-moulding machinery and parts) — flag for correction, not rejection. Revenue and export volume: null, not public in the sources reachable. Net: real trade activity is documented, but the direction of the visible records is import; export shipments are indicated only by counterparty aggregates, not by a dated B/L line — treat as 'заявлено, не подтверждено' pending a paid export-data view.
